parcalar.metin: On a Sunday morning, I found a lion in the forest. But he was the scared one.
You see, I'd run away from the city. I needed some trees.
The bushes moved. That sound... was not a squirrel.
A lion. In Istanbul. In the middle of the forest.
His name was Limon. He got off a ferry, the city noise scared him, and he ran, and ran... all the way here.
Half a simit fixes any trouble.
Will you show me the way?
That day, I didn't find a lost lion. I found a new friend.
